description: Use this when the user asks which US federal regulations or compliance rules cover a topic, including an OSHA, EPA or FDA rule, for example "which regulations mention respirator fit testing?", "find the rules on electronic signatures in title 21" or "where does the CFR define small business?". Pass the words to find and, if known, the CFR title to search in. Returns the best matching sections with citation, heading, an excerpt, the agency and a link; use get_cfr_section to read one in full. This is general information, not legal advice. Do not use it for recent rulemaking news (use search_federal_register), statutes, state law or court decisions.

query.description: Words to find in the current regulations, for example 'electronic signatures' or 'respirator fit testing'.

title.description: Only search this CFR title. Leave out to search all titles.

name: search_cfr
title: Search federal regulations and compliance
